# Integration fixtures

Both JPEGs are cropped from the project's generated fish illustration atlas. They are synthetic UI fixtures, not photographs of real catches.

`catch-with-time.jpg` contains the test EXIF DateTimeOriginal `2024:06:12 06:35:22`. `catch-without-time.jpg` contains no capture timestamp. Use them to verify original-time extraction, missing-time handling, image persistence, and share rendering. Do not include these images as real user catches in the normal album.
